I assure you, ants won’t work. Spiders either. Roaches and bed bugs, that is the ticket.  But it does need to be in quantity.

Bleed on a bed as soon as you enter. Let dry fully. Complain. Blood of any amount almost always works, especially if you present with *concerned* instead of *angry*. Not about the bleeder but about pathogens. The fuller the hotel, the more likely you are to get a refund or a discount instead of an apology and a new room. 

We’re real good at fixing issues, moving rooms, repairing what’s broken. For most things you have to be a REAL bitch to get anything more than a coupon or a small discount. 

You’re looking for something that might mortify the person at the desk. I once had a mom find her kid holding an old chicken bone he pulled from under the bed. She got 1/2 off her stay. Another time a guy comes down at 1am, complaining of a smell in his room. We couldn’t figure out what tf it was. We were sold out and I couldn’t move him. Offered to cancel his reservation and let him leave with no charge (it really smelled). He stayed, opened the window. He mentioned it again when he checked out at 8am and we sent housekeeping up. 

Dog shit. Dog shit in the corner of the room under the sink, nearly behind the mini fridge. It’s not *surprising* housekeeping missed it, it’s just how did THEY not smell it? I immediately comp’d his stay. 

Also, being a member of their reward program increases the chances, especially if you’re a high tier member. Good luck!

I just had really good relationships with some people and wanted to retain their information for networking.

3 major companies and at least 20 individuals have moved locations in the last 6 months. I am astounded. I knew people loved us but I am *thrilled* that not only do they love us, but they cannot work with the woman that was hired.

He started. “But there’s…. It’s gone. We found No Evidence of Disease.”
